title: SIM-1: let SIM-1 declare its Newton dependencies
why: SIM-1.1 and SIM-1.2 import newton, but requirements.txt sits outside SIM-1's touches, so gate and review environments (pip install -r requirements.txt) never have newton and no legal PR can pass; review on PR #10 rejected the runtime pip-install shim and asked for the deps in requirements.txt
